issue.title: Bob Mac Capture: convert a tie (dependency ⇄ plain link) from the relationship pickers

task_type_fields.proposal:
Bob Mac Capture's relationship pickers show each candidate's tie (bob-cli-q8.9: `Prerequisite · ~ needs a label`, `Linked · & replaces the link`, and so on) but have no keys that convert a tie. The Obsidian Task Card stages do (bob-cli-q8.6–q8.8): ⌃B / ⌃⇧B set a dependency (absorbing plain links and reversing an opposite dependency), and ⌃L / ⌃⇧L release a dependency into a plain link after its consequence is on screen. Proposed by bob-cli-q8.9 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #4): give the Mac pickers equivalent convert gestures.

Design constraints the worker must resolve first:
- Mac Capture is a thin client (decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client). Every tie change would need a versioned `bob` subprocess/JSON interface. Today capture can only *add* a dependency (`&`/`*`, which already absorbs), so reversing or releasing needs new bob-cli surface.
- The epic's asymmetry rule (plan:202611/plain_link_dependency_ties.md, "Asymmetry (R3)"; docs/task-relations.md §22) says only an explicit Obsidian stage gesture may release a dependency, because a release can unblock tasks off screen. A Mac release gesture therefore needs an owner decision or a new decisions record, plus a consequence preview at least as explicit as the stage's armed ↵ strip.
- Absorb-only conversions (reversal included) might fit the existing rules without a release; scope those separately from releases.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-q8 plan put Mac-side convert keys out of scope (Phase mac-tie-capsules, step 7) and asked only for this follow-up note. The work needs new bob subprocess/JSON surface and may need a policy change to the release asymmetry, so it can't ride along with the tie epic's landing.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-q8.9 proposed Mac-side tie convert keys as an out-of-scope follow-up; the q8 lander filed it after finding no existing bead for it.
